name: SuperGrok

meters.label: Weekly pool
meters.hint: grok.com or the Grok app: Settings → Usage

reset.rule: Resets once a week on a schedule set per account. The reset date and time are shown in Settings → Usage.
stipulations: One pool covers Chat, Voice, image and video, Grok Build and the API product line. Settings → Usage breaks it down by product.
It is compute-weighted. A video or a long coding task costs much more than a chat message.
xAI shows it only as a percentage and publishes no per-model query counts.
xAI doesn't publish the size of the SuperGrok pool.
Free-tier Chat and Voice limits still apply separately, on their own schedule.
720p video drops to 480p once you hit your tier's 720p cap.

overage: At the limit, paid features pause until the weekly reset. You can buy Extra Usage Credits on the web ($5 minimum) at standard rates, which cost more per action than included usage. Credits expire one year after purchase. Auto Top Up is optional and capped by a monthly limit you set.

how: One weekly pool shared by Chat, Voice, image and video, and Grok Build.
Models: Grok 4.7, Grok 4.6 and Grok 4.5, plus the Imagine and Voice families.
Grok Build CLI (early beta) draws from the same pool.
ext: API calls are billed per token, separately. No API credits are included.
quirks: Closed to new buyers since 12 Oct 2026. You keep the plan until you change or cancel it.
Switching to The X Subscription is permanent and support can't undo it. The old plan is cancelled at checkout and unused time is refunded pro rata.
A plan bought through the App Store has to be cancelled through Apple.
Legacy plans can't use the referral program.
The closest current plan is X Premium ($30), which includes SuperGrok, Cursor Pro and X Premium+ benefits. On this board that is Cursor Premium.
Grok 4.7 Fast is only available in Cursor and Grok Build.
Grok Build allows 8 parallel subagents on SuperGrok (third-party report, unconfirmed).

events.what: No longer sold since 12 Oct 2026. No forced move to The X Subscription has been announced.
